actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: A thoughtful young person with a question is connected by non-directional lines to family, peers, media and youth group. This represents socialization influences with retained agency rather than deterministic programming. Group discussion and generic media icons contain no partisan message or identity stereotype.
actualInspection.phone: At360px all four influence scenes and the central autonomous question remain distinct; major category labels are recognizable.
actualInspection.desktop: At680px the four categories, peer cooperation and youth discussion are clear; no real news story is needed.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The peers face the laptop screen with its outer back toward the audience; the phone and media display are plausible for the right-hand actor. No one reads a reversed legible notebook page.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The selected four contexts are illustrative, not an exhaustive causal account or proof that a specific opinion follows from an identity.
